title: Choose the visual world for Preeti Nursing Bureau
question: The roll assigned the Inland Letter. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Palette stays inside your brief: white and neutral grounds, muted teal, navy, subtle green.

options.label: The Inland Letter
options.lineage: India Post inland letter card and registered-post receipt
options.thesis: A family writes to the bureau; the bureau answers with a receipt number and a phone call, never an instant booking.
materials: folded letter sheet with perforated fold edges
round postmark carrying the reference number
options.viewport: Navy headline on white at left; at right the first fold of the letter sheet is the working request form: choose the service and the 12 or 24 hour arrangement right there.
options.risk: Reads nostalgic or postal if the letter turns into a costume instead of the working form.

raised.raise: Every rule on the letter is a single device-pixel hairline, and the sheet holds to three ink values.
The 12-hour and 24-hour choices are identical faces side by side, read as one row, never a menu.
References, dates and rupee amounts set in tabular numerals everywhere, public and admin.

options.label: The Reservation Chart
options.lineage: Indian Railways reservation chart and PNR slip
options.thesis: Every request gets a PNR-style reference and a status line that moves from received to matched to confirmed by a person.
options.viewport: A reservation slip at the top of the page: service, area, shift, start date filled in as the family types.
options.risk: The most familiar of my list, and booking vocabulary can sound like a guarantee the bureau never makes.

options.label: Centre-rail reference setting
options.thesis: Two dense text columns around a rail of keys.
options.viewport: Twin columns with a vermilion key rail.
options.case: Families in a hurry do not read scholarly apparatus; clarity loses.
options.kept: One-pixel hairline discipline and a three-value ink rule.

options.label: VU meter bridge
options.thesis: A row of identical meters read as one instrument.
options.case: No family identifies care with audio gear.
options.kept: Identical repeated faces as a ruler: the two shift cards.

options.label: Blacksmith scale shower
options.thesis: Each blow visibly changes the metal.
options.case: Violent and dark; wrong scene for a worried family.
options.kept: Tabular force numerals: every figure set to be measured.

options.label: Gravity-rain garden
options.thesis: Rain obeys the colour of each cloud.
options.case: Whimsy undermines trust for medical-adjacent care.

options.label: CRT arcade pixel glow
options.case: Playful gaming register contradicts the brief.

options.label: Emigre bitmap specimen
options.case: Hard to read for older family members.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean home-healthcare site: hero with headline and two buttons, service cards, steps, FAQ, contact.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and two CTAs at left, service highlights at right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other home-care bureau by design.
